value.answer: Depends on your down payment. If you're putting down under 20% (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed I can find today is 4.34%, from lenders like Frank Mortgage. If you're putting down 20% or more (uninsured), the lowest is about 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates have been creeping up this month.
